title: 2022 Panini Score Minnesota Vikings Huddle Up #HU-MIN Cousins
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2022 Panini Score Minnesota Vikings Huddle Up card is a must-have for any football fan. Featuring the star players Justin Jefferson, Kirk Cousins, and Dalvin Cook, this sports trading card is an insert from the 2022 Score set. The card number is HU-MIN and it is perfect for collectors or fans of the National Football League (NFL). 

The card is manufactured by Panini and is a type of trading card single. It falls under the categories of Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Sports Trading Cards. This card is a great addition to any collection and is a perfect way to show your support for the Minnesota Vikings.
